WLED Oval / Polar Ledmap Generator

Places LEDs on concentric ovals or on a warped matrix of strips, snaps each one to the nearest cell of an oversized 2D matrix, and writes a sparse ledmap.json (empty cells are -1).

Fixture
Straight-ish strips side by side, bowed toward the fixture outline so that the strip ends trace the oval. 0% warp is a plain matrix clipped to the oval; 100% is an elliptical grid mapping in which the outermost strips follow the outline. Every strip is an arc of an ellipse; with the limit on, the warp is lowered until no strip bends (in its own plane) tighter than the minimum bend radius.
Center line 0% ends in a single center LED (scaled rings); 100% gives the longest line, where the ring gap is the same on both axes. A longer line evens out the gaps between rings. "Even spacing" rings avoid the bunching that plain ellipses show between the axes.
Wiring
The first strip is the outermost one on the start corner's side; it starts at its end nearest that corner. Serpentine reverses every other strip, otherwise all strips run the same way.
0° = top (12 o'clock); angles increase clockwise. Every ring starts at the start angle, viewed from the front.
Matrix
Square matrix: the LEDs' bounding box is split into N × N cells, so cells are stretched along the long axis. Effects that draw round shapes (or size themselves to the shorter side) then fill the whole fixture, stretched with it.
Smaller cells = more accurate placement, but more RAM and render time. Max 255×255.
Preview
ledmap.json
In WLED: set the LED count under LED Preferences to the total LED count, upload this as /ledmap.json via /edit, then reboot. The test image has 8×8 pixels per matrix cell (so it is 8× the matrix size) and paints every ring or strip in its own color (see the details table), with black away from the LEDs; a color change along a strip or ring means the map does not match the fixture. The matrix only spans the mapped cells (no empty border rows or columns). In Pixel Forge, use "match size" and place the crop exactly on the image before uploading.
Layout template (PDF)
Print at 100% / "Actual size" (no "fit to page"), then check the scale bar on each page. Page 1 is an overview showing where every sheet goes; the full-size sheets carry a 1 in / 20 mm grid centered on the fixture for alignment. Trim each sheet along its dashed line on the right and bottom edges and lay it over the overlap of the neighboring sheets.
